spec.expr: count by (job, service_version) (target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}) unless count by (job, service_version) (target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"} offset 5m)

spec.description: Overview bounded context payments: health, runtime, зависимости и бизнес-поток. Сгенерировано ops/grafana; правки — через генератор.

spec.title: Request rate by entry
spec.description: Входящая работа по типу входа: gRPC, GraphQL/HTTP, обработка Kafka, Temporal Activities.

spec.expr: sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Latency ≤ 0.25s: SLI / SLO 95%
spec.description: Доля хороших событий в шаге графика против цели 95% за 30d (ADR 40).

spec.expr: 1 - (1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.25"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))
vector(0.95)

spec.title: Latency ≤ 0.25s: error budget remaining (30d)
spec.description: Неизрасходованная доля бюджета 0.05 за скользящие 30d. Ниже нуля — SLO нарушен.

spec.expr: 1 - (1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.25"}[30d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[30d])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[30d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[30d]))) / 0.05

spec.title: Latency ≤ 0.25s: burn rate
spec.description: Скорость расхода бюджета: 1 — бюджет кончится ровно за 30d. Пороги: 14.4 за 1h (critical), 6 за 6h (warning), 1 за 3d.

spec.expr: (1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.25"}[1h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[1h])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[1h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[1h]))) / 0.05

(1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.25"}[6h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[6h])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[6h]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[6h]))) / 0.05

(1 - sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", le="0.25"}[3d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[3d])) / sum(increase(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})"}[3d]) and on (job, instance) max_over_time(target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[3d]))) / 0.05

spec.title: CPU by mode
spec.description: Метрики: `process_cpu_time_seconds_total`.

spec.expr: sum by (cpu_mode) (rate(process_cpu_time_seconds_total{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Ready pods
spec.description: Разрыв ready и pods — pod не проходит readinessProbe и выведен из Service.

spec.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_ready{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", condition="true"})
count(kube_pod_status_ready{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+", condition="true"})

spec.title: Restarts
spec.description: Метрики: `kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total`.

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Waiting containers by reason
spec.description: CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff и т. п.: контейнер не запущен.

spec.expr: sum by (reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"})

spec.title: CPU by pod
spec.description: Ядра CPU (cAdvisor), включая то, что runtime не видит (GC, sidecar-процессы контейнера).

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Errors by class
spec.description: Transport/availability (CANCELLED, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, UNAVAILABLE), application (UNKNOWN, UNIMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL, DATA_LOSS) и business rejection (INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, ALREADY_EXISTS, PERMISSION_DENIED, FAILED_PRECONDITION, ABORTED, OUT_OF_RANGE, UNAUTHENTICATED). Бизнес-результаты в OK-ответе (PaymentDeclined) ошибками не являются.

spec.expr: sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"CANCELLED|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|UNAVAILABLE"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"UNKNOWN|UNIMPLEMENTED|INTERNAL|DATA_LOSS"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"INVALID_ARGUMENT|NOT_FOUND|ALREADY_EXISTS|PERMISSION_DENIED|FAILED_PRECONDITION|ABORTED|OUT_OF_RANGE|UNAUTHENTICATED"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Memory working set by pod
spec.description: Метрики: `container_memory_working_set_bytes`.

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"})

spec.title: Network by pod
spec.description: Метрики: `container_network_receive_bytes_total`, `container_network_transmit_bytes_total`.

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="infra/kubernetes", namespace="nomnom-payments", pod=~"(${service:pipe})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: postgresql: pool connections
spec.description:
Сумма по процессам и пулам. Насыщение одного пула — панель «pool saturation».

Часть запросов ждёт метрик: db_client_connection_idle_min, db_client_connection_max (см. docs/observability/metric-inventory.md).

spec.expr: sum by (db_client_connection_state) (db_client_connection_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"} and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Technical error ratio
spec.description: Доля transport + application ошибок; business rejections исключены.

spec.expr: sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", rpc_response_status_code=~"CANCELLED|DEADLINE_EXCEEDED|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|UNAVAILABLE|UNKNOWN|UNIMPLEMENTED|INTERNAL|DATA_LOSS"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}) / sum(rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Produced (Outbox, Debezium)
spec.description: События Outbox, которые коннектор `payments-outbox` прочитал из журнала базы и отправил в Kafka (ADR 37).

spec.expr: sum(rate(debezium_metrics_TotalNumberOfEventsSeen{job="infra/kafka-connect", name="payments-outbox"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Outbox CDC lag
spec.description: Отставание коннектора `payments-outbox` от журнала базы: время от commit записи Outbox до её чтения.

spec.expr: max(debezium_metrics_MilliSecondsBehindSource{job="infra/kafka-connect", name="payments-outbox"}) / 1000

spec.title: Outbox connector tasks
spec.description: Состояние задачи коннектора `payments-outbox`: `failed` — Outbox не доставляется.

spec.expr: sum by (status) (kafka_connect_connector_task_status{job="infra/kafka-connect", connector="payments-outbox"})

spec.title: Transitions
spec.description: Метрики: `nomnom_fsm_transitions_total`.

spec.expr: sum by (nomnom_fsm_aggregate_type, nomnom_fsm_to_state) (rate(nomnom_fsm_transitions_total{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", nomnom_fsm_result="applied"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Invalid transitions
spec.description: Метрики: `nomnom_fsm_transitions_total`.

spec.expr: sum by (nomnom_fsm_aggregate_type, nomnom_fsm_from_state, nomnom_fsm_trigger) (rate(nomnom_fsm_transitions_total{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", nomnom_fsm_result="rejected"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

spec.title: Terminal transitions
spec.description: Метрики: `nomnom_fsm_transitions_total`.

spec.expr: sum by (nomnom_fsm_aggregate_type, nomnom_fsm_to_state) (rate(nomnom_fsm_transitions_total{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance", nomnom_fsm_result="applied", nomnom_fsm_terminal="true"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"})

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", instance=~"$service_instance"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) target_info{job=~"nomnom/(${service:pipe})", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: Используемые CPU-ядра процесса (rate process.cpu.time).
